# Lab 13.6: AI.AGG

## What We Are Going to Do
Use AI.AGG (Preview) to summarise many rows into one answer per group, for example the overall opinion about each movie.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] One summary per movie.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  title,
  COUNT(*) AS reviews,
  AI.AGG(review, 'You will be given user reviews of one movie. Summarise the overall opinion in two sentences.') AS overall_opinion
FROM `bigquery-public-data.imdb.reviews`
WHERE title IN (SELECT title FROM lab13.reviews GROUP BY title LIMIT 3)
GROUP BY title;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] One summary for a whole table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT AI.AGG(title, 'These are news headlines. List the 5 most common themes as bullet points.') AS themes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   AI.AGG batches the rows, summarises each batch, then summarises the summaries. It can handle more text than one Gemini call.

3. **[SQL] Combine AI.AGG with AI.CLASSIFY.** First let AI.AGG suggest categories:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT AI.AGG(title,
  'Suggest exactly 4 short category names for these headlines. Reply only with the names separated by commas.') AS suggested
FROM (SELECT title FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext` LIMIT 300);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Then paste the 4 names into AI.CLASSIFY to label each row:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title, AI.CLASSIFY(title, categories =&gt; ['CATEGORY_1', 'CATEGORY_2', 'CATEGORY_3', 'CATEGORY_4']) AS category
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext` LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Run AI.AGG from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
"SELECT AI.AGG(title, 'In one sentence, what are these headlines mostly about?') AS theme FROM (SELECT title FROM \`bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext\` WHERE category = 'sport' LIMIT 100)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

| Thing | Reality |
